package.description: A modern, polyglot systems programming language with post-quantum cryptography

en-US.description: A modern, polyglot systems programming language with post-quantum cryptography
en-US.longDescription:
Fusion v2.0 Vortex is a general-purpose, polyglot systems programming language
designed for the post-quantum era. Features include algebraic effects, linear types,
dependent types, refinement types, tail-call optimization, actors, pattern matching,
post-quantum cryptography, quantum computing primitives, blockchain modules,
and a multi-target compiler (LLVM/WASM/bytecode).
en-US.name: Fusion Programming Language
